title: Safari Smash Sandbag : a Home Run Contest brawler with animals [browser, free, mobile]
author: gun2000
selftext:
Play on Newgrounds : [https://www.newgrounds.com/portal/view/1056855](https://www.newgrounds.com/portal/view/1056855)

Play on my website : [https://magiadev.ovh/sss/](https://magiadev.ovh/sss/) 

Ten seconds to beat up a sandbag, then you smash it as far as you can. Pick an animal fighter (a luchador chicken, a karate monkey, a mafia tiger, an astronaut pig...), pick a bag (anvil, beach ball, Vespa, bottle rocket...) and send it flying.

* 3 buttons: high, mid, low. Hold to charge, chain them for secret specials
* Super Smash: lock the angle, nail the timing dial, watch it vanish over the horizon
* 12 modes: Story, Arcade gauntlet, Break the Targets, Car Crush, Pinball, a rocket trip to the Moon, 20 challenges...
* 118 achievements, works with keyboard, gamepad and touch for mobile

No download, no login, progress saves in your browser. 

Game design and voices by me, code written with Claude (AI), music made with Google Flow Music.

[Download the booklet here.](https://magiadev.ovh/sss/booklet.pdf)
